DSHA v0.2.0-rc2 (commit `8362bba747fcf84c19e436c3dbb594a0fc388a67`) is the reference for running Ubuntu userspace through PRoot on Android. DSHA application code is MIT, copyright 2026 qiannianhuanxiang. This implementation uses the nativeLibraryDir launcher/loader architecture and fixed release guest archives; it does not ship DSHA's proprietary Proroot binaries, DSH bundle, or device bridges. The Android/Kotlin installer and safe archive reader are implemented in this repository, using the existing Apache Commons Compress dependency.

The packaged native ELF files are unchanged official Termux artifacts, renamed to `liblinux_*.so` for APK extraction. The PRoot executable/loaders are GPL-2.0-or-later, copyright STMicroelectronics and the contributors named in COPYING and the complete source archive. The talloc 2.5.0 library and its replacement routines are LGPL-3.0-or-later; its complete source tree contains other licenses, including GPL build/support material. Both GPL-3.0 and LGPL-3.0 texts are preserved. libandroid-shmem 0.7 is BSD-3-Clause, copyright 2013 Sergii Pylypenko and 2017 Fredrik Fornwall. These licenses are independent of DSHA's MIT license.

`runtime-lock.json` records each exact DEB, unchanged ELF digest, upstream source archive digest and packaging commit. Complete PRoot, libandroid-shmem, talloc and Termux build-system source archives accompany the APK under `assets/linux-runtime/sources`; they are prepared by `tools/prepare-linux-runtime.ps1` through the explicit local proxy, and are data only. The fixed build recipes are retained here. Official DEB hashes and source hashes have been checked; a byte-for-byte reconstruction of the upstream DEBs has not been performed.

The guest installer downloads the DSHA release APK with SHA-256 `1fedf883d431af658d89c28b86d85974cc1d11b74e0c5d46ef3d3cf8650b1961`, and independently verifies each selected asset. The optimized standard `offline-rootfs.bin` digest is `b9fe8a0460bc0d0e96f1cec0d65d46c9ff71a10c6a8d05a390b732a81d30cef3`; the source descriptor's pre-optimization digest is not used. Ubuntu package `/usr/share/doc`, `/usr/share/common-licenses`, npm package licenses and pnpm package license files are retained during extraction. Node v24.19.0's complete LICENSE is retained here and accompanies the APK. Node's license comes from the official v24.19.0 source tag at commit `cdc1b38d40cb567b7ad0b39c86addf830a0af0ae`, SHA-256 `148eacf7863ef4329224a29398623077200a27194aa075569faf4a0a85566ca5`.

PRoot translates userspace paths and system calls and shares the Android kernel. It is not a full virtual machine or security sandbox, and the guest root identity does not grant Android root. Executables and loaders run from the APK's Android native library directory; writable guest ELF files are passed to PRoot, never directly executed by Android. The packaged architecture is arm64-v8a, and real execution on a given vendor kernel requires device validation.
